subtasks: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the objects.
Use the brush in the right hand to sweep the small white piece at the far corner of the dustpan into the middle of the pan. Keep the other four pieces inside.
Sweep both remaining loose pieces just to the right of the dustpan opening fully into the pan with the right-hand brush. Keep the dustpan still.

All five objects are inside the dustpan. Set the dustpan down level without spilling them, set the brush down on the table more than 10 centimeters to its right, open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
The white piece rolled out after release. Regrasp the brush with the right hand, sweep the white piece back into the dustpan, then release the brush to the right and return both arms home.
Withdraw the brush from the pan, release it on the right, and immediately return both open arms to their initial home poses. Leave the loaded pan alone.
